working_title: The Tied Arm That Proved Your Blood Circulates
title: The Vessels He Never Saw

chapter_card.treatment: soft cross-fade after the last word + 0.6 s breath; music continues

set_language: Warm candlelit 17th-century world: dark oak, cream linen, brass, leather books, London fog. Body cutaways are clean, glowing illustrations (warm red arteries, cool blue veins), never anatomical gore. Say 'same 1616 London lecture room' or 'same Harvey study' for continuity; never 'same DNA'.
explorer_lock: ONE beat (plate 06): the Explorer leans in to Malpighi's microscope, adjusts his round glasses, looks, then pulls back with a gasp. Attach the Explorer reference.
forbidden: HARD REJECT: Orbit robot; photoreal; Ken Burns or still push; gore, wounds, blood on skin, cut flesh or real animal organs (animal hearts only as Harvey's ink drawings); live or dead animals on a table; lava drip / molten bead; underside lamp bulb or shade cup; unfinished flat cards; garbled writing; unfinished Explorer hair; DNA helix; readable text or logos baked into the plate (labels and the De Motu Cordis title are added in the edit); twin Explorer; faces in the first two seconds of the film. Never say 'same DNA' or 'lab DNA' in a Veo prompt.
always_fails: garbled card text or wrong sums (2 oz, 1/8, 1000 checked by hand)
unfinished Explorer hair or melted face
gore: wound, blood on skin, cut flesh, real animal organs
a face in the first two seconds of the film
motion_lock: Real Veo camera and object motion on every plate. No freeze-pad, no loop, no Ken Burns.
quality_note: Flow Veo 3.1 on the Mac Mini CDP worker, benoats@googlemail.com only. Quality for anything with light (candles, glowing loop, stove heart) and every hero plate; Fast only for low-risk garnish. One plate at a time until the first KEEP; after 2 same-framing FAILs change the framing.
labels: White Didot italic side label, 1-4 words, one at a time, on the plate's first beat; added in the edit.

plates.vo_land: Harvey's circle had a hole in it.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. The glowing loop from Part 03: at the far end, where the red arteries should meet the blue veins, there is a dark gap and the glow fades. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Harvey guessed the blood passed through tiny gaps in the flesh, too small to see.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A soft, warm magnified view of flesh: red seeps through tiny unseen gaps, blurred and uncertain, as Harvey guessed. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: He never saw them.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. London in the 1650s: old William Harvey, about seventy-five, white hair and small white pointed beard, same olive skin and dark eyes, black gown, at a window, a candle by his book; he closes it gently. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Four years later, in Bologna, a doctor called Marcello Malpighi looked at the thin lung of a frog through a microscope.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Bologna, 1661: Marcello Malpighi, a doctor of about thirty-three, long dark curled wig, brown 1660s coat with white cravat, at a brass microscope by a bright window, adjusting it. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+5.0 s into) Four years later, in Bologna, a doctor called Marcello Malpighi looked at the thin lung of a frog through a microscope.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Close on Malpighi's hands placing a thin glass slide with a pale pink film on it under the brass lens. No animal on screen. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: And there it was.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same Bologna study. Exactly ONE Explorer, on model: a young boy, messy wavy brown hair (full crown), round thin gold glasses, long teal coat, tan waistcoat, brown bow tie, satchel. He acts, then leaves. He leans in to the brass microscope, adjusts his round glasses, looks, then pulls back with a gasp. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame.

plates.vo_land: (+2.7 s into) A net of tiny vessels, finer than hairs, carrying blood from the smallest arteries into the smallest veins.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Through the eyepiece in a soft round vignette: a mesh of tiny vessels finer than hairs joins a red artery to a blue vein; blood creeps through. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: We call them capillaries, from the Latin word for hair.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same mesh beside a single hair for scale; the tiny vessels glow as the blood creeps through them. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: The circle was closed.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. The glowing loop closes: heart, arteries, capillaries, veins and back to the heart, glowing all the way round. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+3.4 s into) Your blood leaves your heart, runs out through your arteries, crosses through the capillaries, and comes home through your veins.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A simple glowing body outline with the full circuit lit: out through the arteries, across the capillaries, home through the veins. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: So why was this so groundbreaking?
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same glowing circuit pulses steadily. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Because once you know the blood goes round, you know that anything put into one vein reaches the whole body.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A single soft blue glow enters one vein of the glowing body outline and spreads round the whole circuit. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Within ten years of Harvey's death, doctors in England and France were trying the first blood transfusions.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. 1660s, candlelit: two physicians in wigs bend over a table with a slender silver tube, a quill and a pewter bowl. Tools only: no animal, no patient, no blood. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+5.5 s into) Within ten years of Harvey's death, doctors in England and France were trying the first blood transfusions.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Close on the silver tube and quills laid out on linen by candlelight; a hand writes in a ledger (no readable text). Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: And the next time a nurse wraps a cuff round your arm, think of Harvey.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. A modern blood pressure cuff tightens round a bare upper arm, arm only, no face, in a bright clean room. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: It squeezes until the blood stops getting in, then lets go, and listens for the moment it starts to flow again.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Same cuff eases off; a stethoscope disc listens at the inside of the elbow. Arm only, no face. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: A sum, a band, and a row of little doors.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Harvey's linen band on the old oak table in candlelight, beside the page of sums and Fabricius's vein drawing. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: Harvey proved that your heart is a pump and that your blood goes round, long before anyone saw the last link.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Harvey's painted heart chart; the glowing loop draws itself over it and runs round. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.

plates.vo_land: (+4.4 s into) Harvey proved that your heart is a pump and that your blood goes round, long before anyone saw the last link.
plates.prompt: Premium Animistry-class 3D cartoon. Malpighi's brass microscope by the bright Bologna window, the last link, glowing softly. Silent. Continuous motion through the final frame. No Explorer.
